etsy.title: Teamwork Poster, Teamwork Zone Classroom Sign, Group Work Table Decor, Collaboration Office Wall Art
etsy.description:
A simple teamwork poster marking a Teamwork Zone for group work tables, classroom collaboration stations, and shared office spaces.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang near a group table, project corner, or collaboration station in a classroom or office.

This listing is a physical poster print, not a substitute for professional medical, therapy, or educational advice. Thank you for supporting a small, neurodivergent-run shop!

competitorNotes: Etsy teamwork listings lean on slogans ('teamwork makes the dream work') and rule lists; a plain zone label for a group table is less common.
Most are instant-download printables; vinyl decals and canvas cost more.
Most shared-project results (sensory room, calm corner, neurodiversity decor) are digital printables; stating 'physical poster print' separates this listing.
Amazon teamwork decor is multi-poster classroom sets and framed office quote canvases, often 8x10 to 16x24, framed or unframed.
Some listings stress matte finish to avoid glare in offices.

research.notes: Artwork reads 'Teamwork Zone', so teamwork phrases beat 'collaboration'. Listing pages were not reachable from this environment (WebFetch blocked); evidence is from search results only. No priceRange: snippets mixed digital downloads with physical signs and did not separate physical poster prices.
